Privacy

hexbot.app sets no cookies and collects no personal information. It has no analytics or third-party scripts.

The pairing page reads the daemon address from the query string and the pairing code from the URL fragment. Browsers do not send fragments to web servers, and the page does not transmit or store the code.

When you open the Hexbot app, the app connects to the daemon address in your pairing link. Your conversations and provider credentials do not pass through this website.

Hexbot is AGPL-3.0 software.No tracking. No cookies.
